description:
A regional hazmat team requires a quick-reference classification report for five chemicals stored at an industrial facility. Use the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) to look up the 'Protective Clothing' recommendations for each chemical. 

For each chemical, determine if standard structural firefighter's protective clothing 'provides limited protection' (Classify as LEVEL_B) or 'will NOT provide adequate protection' (Classify as LEVEL_A). Also check if Positive Pressure SCBA is recommended.

Chemicals to classify:
1. Acetone (UN 1090)
2. Chlorine (UN 1017)
3. Hydrogen Cyanide (UN 1051)
4. Toluene (UN 1294)
5. Phosgene (UN 1076)

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/protective_clothing_report.txt'.

Format for each entry:
CHEMICAL: [Name]
UN_NUMBER: [Number]
STRUCTURAL_GEAR_ADEQUATE: [YES/NO]
SCBA_REQUIRED: [YES/NO]
CLASSIFICATION: [LEVEL_A/LEVEL_B]
---

After all entries, include a summary:
SUMMARY
LEVEL_A_CHEMICALS: [comma-separated names]
LEVEL_B_CHEMICALS: [comma-separated names]
